files.design.md:
# Archive design

## Accepted answers

ZIP keeps relative filenames. An empty selection writes an empty archive and reports Archive created: 0 entries, which assumes the file was written.

## Questions

Existing-archive behavior is open.

ZIP keeps relative filenames. An empty selection refuses without writing an archive. Report that no files were selected. Do not report an archive was created.

## Questions

Existing-archive behavior is open.
examples.reason: Explaining the accepted refusal does not create another product choice or claim the user selected exact words.
